WHO MAKES CAL-STATE RUN (OR FLY)? Some people have the
mistaken belief that airplanes make an air line. We disagree. At
CAL-STATE, we are dedicated to the belief that it also takes people
-carefully selected and well trained people.
It takes people to fly the planes, and it takes people to keep them
in perfect condition. It takes people to man our ground installa-
tions; plan our schedules; supervise our operations; even keep our
operating cost records-so that we can give you the lowest pos-
sible fares.
It will interest you to know that CAL-STATE selected its key per-
sonnel-men with years of experience in the air lines industry,
who are responsible for these activities-many months before our
routes were determined and our planes were ordered. This was
our way of making certain that CAL-STATE would be the most
nige airline of it kind. And,making good on our claim that
"UP TO NOW... THERE'S NEVER BEEN AN AIR LINE LIKE
CAL-STATE."
